role_definitions.AUTHORITY: Owns a business decision and is the only writer of that state.
role_definitions.PROJECTION: Deterministically derives a read model from authoritative accepted evidence.
role_definitions.COORDINATOR: Orders work across owners without acquiring their mutation rights.
role_definitions.REPOSITORY: Persists state inside an owning transaction and has no business decision right.
role_definitions.EVIDENCE: Records an observation or proof input without making it accepted truth.
role_definitions.CANDIDATE: May be reviewed or decided but is not active or accepted merely because it exists.
role_definitions.ACCEPTED_FACT: Has crossed its owning acceptance boundary and may feed canonical projections.

semantic_constraints.statement: Current Chapter activation requires Mission/Scene v2 views from one immutable Planning asset and exact Frozen realization. Semantic replan includes Mission, trajectory, obligation, Scene and execution commitments; replay-only older definitions cannot admit new production.

Current Planning owns Arc plans and Character trajectory references, while Narrative State derives accepted relationship changes. Independent typed relationship/thematic trajectory portfolios and their activation/closure owner are not implemented; generic fields or Arc projection cannot prove this target capability.

Independent whole-book cases assess exact accepted history and append decisions, but native Quality human evidence is scoped to Chapter/Arc preference. A typed whole-book editorial authorization and closure-evaluator policy is absent; whole-book ACCEPTED is blocked rather than inferred from a completed cursor or AI review.
Book acceptance atomically advances the cursor and binds ChapterOutcome, Canon, Narrative State, long-form projections, audit, and outbox evidence.
An external request that may have started must reconcile durable intent and receipt evidence before any retry.
Draft, Canon extraction, and ChapterOutcome candidate evidence is not visible as accepted actual before Book acceptance.
Raw source material is excluded from production draft context; reusable source knowledge must cross Source and MKAOS governance.
Arc identity is independent of the Volume containment parent chain and one Arc may cross Volumes.
ChapterGroup ranges require positive contiguous bounds. A versioned execution policy owns maximum and preferred lengths, freezes per Book run and cannot change existing bindings on replay.
The runtime currently uses BOOK, VOLUME, ARC, CHAPTER_GROUP, and CHAPTER contracts with strategic, tactical, and operational horizons.
Book Opening currently materializes five durable workflow layers before Book production admission.
Chapter quality thresholds are frozen Capability Pack and quality-profile policy values, not universal domain invariants.
Attempt limits differ by frozen operation definition and runtime policy; only positivity and fenced replay are domain constraints.
Context token ceilings and selection profiles are runtime policy selected per stage and capability.
Quality qualification currently requires at least two evaluator identities; larger counts remain manifest policy.
Pre-hierarchy plan shapes are accepted only through the explicit legacy migration adapter compatibility flag.

ReaderProxy policy owns advisory score cutoffs, bands and issue thresholds. Immutable PostgreSQL versions freeze at admission and survive selection changes during recovery; observations never gain human or accepted-fact authority.

narrative_model.lifecycle_rule: Planning realization binds Character trajectory references to semantic Character Cast, Character Arc Portfolio or Book Plan versions. These references are not a separate plan scale and cannot advance accepted Character state.

Accepted relationship state is normalized under Narrative State identities and derives from accepted outcomes. Relationship design remains Character/Foundation input; no independent active relationship trajectory plan is implied.

Immutable completion cases bind exact accepted Chapter/projection identities and closure findings. Versioned decisions can reject or record blockers; native whole-book editorial authorization is missing and ACCEPTED remains unavailable.
Creative Foundation supplies intent and tradeoffs; the active semantic version remains owned by Story Design.
Theme binds exact upstream Creative Foundation and qualification; it is not an accepted thematic outcome.
Reader Promise is an active semantic commitment, not observed reader response.
Ending Intent constrains design reachability and does not establish whole-book completion.
World Bible is a semantic Foundation input; accepted world events remain Canon and Narrative State.
Character Cast is a semantic Foundation input with motivations and relationship functions, not accepted character history.
QualifiedFoundationSet binds six exact active semantic versions and qualification digests. Book Design owns this binding set; Story Design alone owns the bound semantic facts.
BookDesign candidates may be decided and one version activated; activation establishes design input, not accepted story actual.
The BOOK contract binds approved Book Design and strategic structure, character development and disclosure obligations; it is not BookDesign candidate ownership.
A Volume is a typed strategic plan structurally parented by the Book plan.
Segments encode ordered internal progression and state handoffs; they do not form a universal containment parent for Arcs.
An Arc plan has independent identity and may span multiple Volumes.
Arc actual movement is derived from accepted chapter outcomes and cannot be advanced by plan text.

ChapterGroup is a positive contiguous coordination window selected under a frozen versioned execution policy. Maximum and preferred length are policy, not narrative invariants; it never owns Chapter Attempt, Lease, Fence or ExternalEffect.
One immutable Chapter plan carries separately validated Mission and Scene Architecture views. Current activation requires mission-scene.v2 and exact Frozen realization; old contracts are replay-only.
Mission freezes chapter intent, primary function, Arc/trajectory/obligation references, state transitions and realization events from the owning Chapter plan.
Scene coverage must exactly realize Mission commitments; unknown, missing or duplicate references reject current plan admission and activation.
Typed ordered Beat identities are Scene-scoped and compile into ExecutionIntent; they are not independent active plan state.
The independently approved and frozen event-chain realization is a domain/execution contract, not a repository Proposal, plan scale or accepted actual.
A draft remains candidate content through review, revision, quality, and release gates.
A ChapterOutcome becomes accepted actual only in the Book acceptance transaction.
Canon exposes approved or Book-bound accepted facts; extraction alone is not Canon.
Narrative State is a deterministic as-of projection over accepted evidence.
Chapter Mission obligation actions bind exact obligation identities and Scene realization coverage; future-only replanning cannot rewrite accepted payoff history.
Accepted obligation setup, due-window and payoff state is projected only from accepted Chapters. Planned obligation actions remain distinct Planning commitments.
Reader proxy, preference and behavior evidence retain their evidence class. Versioned ReaderProxy policy is frozen at admission and is not human, causal or production proof.
Immutable Book-accepted source identity references exact Outcome, State, Canon, projection set and sequential parent; it has no independent fact writer.
Causal predicates precede Director ranking; selected futures remain planning proposals and cannot mutate accepted reality.
Accepted obligations retain exact causal-plan origin and executable predicate; only accepted payoff evidence can fulfill debt.
Frozen Scene capabilities and actor-local knowledge select ordered prose slots; integration is exact and revisions rerun Quality and Actual reconciliation.
